title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with The Gillette Company.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the Company's Proposed Agreement . The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensetive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Judith F. Judson, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul G. Afonso and Brian Paul Golden. (DTE 06-GC-4)
